notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation, and the revised one presses B1 on the Ø8 tube and slips the nut slots (N1) and set-screw holes (S1), with the tooth count held at 40T. The dimensions and fits are in 421-001_InternalOuterPulley.scad's header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
